newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: HARVEYS BUYS KLIFRIDGE FOR 150 MLN RAND.
newsitem.headline: HARVEYS BUYS KLIFRIDGE FOR 150 MLN RAND.

text.p: Harveys Curnow said on Monday it had acquired all the shares in Klifridge Investments Holdings (Pty) Ltd for 150 million rand to be settled by the issue of 417.5 million new Harveys shares at an issue price of 36 cents per share to the current shareholders of Klifridge.
The transaction is with effect from September 1, 1996.
Harveys also said that it would undergo a change of control.
It said that Klifridge shareholders would make an offer to Harveys minority shareholders to acquire all or part of their Harveys shares for a cash consideration.
An issue of 28 million new Harveys shares at 36 cents per share for cash would be made to raise about 10 million rand to eliminate Harveys' borrowings.
Harveys cautioned its shareholders in their dealings as negotiations for a further acquisition were taking place which, if successful, could affect the share price of Harveys.
